summary: Architecture review of PR #1524 (the linear rebuild of #1488) found a CRITICAL. provable (go/internal/phases/ship/gate_step_runner.go:37-43) treats a step key as provable when ciparity.GateStepOfKey finds a row, but 5 of the 6 GateSteps rows (make cover-changed, apicover-check, cover-strict and the two darwin rows) read the coverage.txt of make test-integration, which a ship lane never makes. When main goes red at a coverage gate, the stop opens, the fix lane runs the gate, it exits 2, and Admit refuses the fix as not-a-fix: false refusals at shadow, a deadlock until MainRedStopBound at enforce. #1488 was blocked more than 3 times, so it returns to design. The review is saved at docs evidence: scratchpad r1488/critical-review.md; a prescribed HIGH fix (GateStepOfKey matches only the Gate name) is saved as gatekey-high-fix.patch.
